class.name: IfcFillAreaStyleTiles
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The fill area style tiles defines a two dimensional tile to be used for the filling of annotation fill areas or other closed regions. The content of a tile is defined by the tile set, and the placement of each tile determined by the filling pattern which indicates how to place tiles next to each other. members.member: A two direction repeat factor defining the shape and relative positioning of the tiles. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
A set of constituents of the tile. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.
The scale factor applied to each tile as it is placed in the annotation fill area. A float, or null when unset.
